relations: The white vapor plume drifts and swirls across the dark counter, continuously changing shape without settling.
Fixed objects like the mug and background bottles remain stationary while the vapor moves around them.
The dense vapor body folds and thins, sending billows toward the lower left and curling back toward the center.
A faint loop-shaped object is intermittently visible through the moving vapor near the middle of the scene.
caption: The video captures a kitchen counter seen at a slight angle, where a broad plume of white vapor drifts and swirls across the dark surface. On the right, a white mug with partial lettering rests on a reflective silver appliance, while a bright window fills the background with bottles, including a blue-capped container and a spray bottle. The vapor is already moving and continues to change shape throughout the scene. Its dense body folds and thins, sending soft billows toward the lower left and curling clouds back toward the center. A faint loop-shaped object is intermittently visible through the moving vapor near the middle of the scene. The surrounding objects remain fixed, so the visible motion belongs mainly to the shifting cloud. The plume does not settle into a stable form; instead, its edges stretch, merge, and dissipate in slow, irregular patterns. The vapor remains swirling above the counter, while its source and ultimate fate are not shown.
